full_prompt_en: The image is a square fantasy character illustration arranged like a dramatic group poster. Four cloaked human figures occupy the lower two thirds, their shoulders overlapping in a shallow row. At the far left, an older white-haired man in profile looks outward with a stern face and heavy gray fur around his shoulders. In front of him stands a younger dark-haired woman wearing a brown cloak, her face turned left. Near the center, a pale woman with long white hair faces right, her hair falling over a thick gray fur collar and dark garment. At the right edge, a bearded man in brown fur looks downward and to the right. Behind all four, an immense gray dragon head extends from the upper center to the right edge. Angular horns, ridged scales, a narrow red eye, and rows of pointed teeth make the creature both detailed and imposing. A rough dark red field rises behind the dragon, with uneven torn-looking edges against an off-white surrounding ground. The palette is restrained: cold gray and charcoal for the dragon, muted brown and cream for skin and clothing, and deep crimson for the backdrop. Fine linear detail describes hair, fur, scale, and facial planes; broad shadow masses keep each figure readable despite the crowding. The light is soft and cool, picking out faces and pale hair while the dragon recedes through layered gray texture. There is no literal landscape beneath them, only the graphic grouping of profiles and the red vertical shape. The composition has a clear hierarchy from human faces to the larger reptilian silhouette overhead. Its mood is solemn and foreboding, carried by intricate surface work, opposing gazes, and a compact poster arrangement rather than active movement.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形奇幻人物插画，布局如同戏剧化的群像海报。四名披斗篷的人占据下方三分之二，肩部在浅纵深中重叠。最左侧，白发老人以侧面望向画外，神情严厉，肩上围着厚灰毛。其前站着一位深发年轻女子，穿褐色斗篷，脸向左转。中央附近，一位长白发的浅肤女子朝右，头发垂在厚灰毛领和深色衣服上。右边，一位有胡须的男子裹着褐色毛皮，向右下方看。四人身后，巨大的灰龙头从上方中央伸到右边缘。棱角状角、隆起鳞片、细窄红眼和一排尖齿让它细致且具有压迫感。龙背后升起一片粗糙深红区域，其不规则破边与周围米白底相接。配色克制：龙用冷灰与炭色，皮肤和衣服用暗褐与奶油色，背景用深绯红。细线刻画头发、毛皮、鳞片和面部平面；大片阴影使拥挤人群里的每个人仍可辨认。光柔和而冷，挑亮脸和浅发，让龙在层层灰色肌理中后退。人物脚下没有具体地貌，只有侧面群像与红色竖向形状的图形组合。构图从人脸到上方更大的爬行动物剪影有清楚层级。细密表面、互不一致的视线和紧凑海报布局，而非动作，承载了庄严且不祥的气氛。
style_prompt_en: Detailed fantasy illustration organizes several close silhouettes beneath a larger looming form. A restrained range of cold gray, charcoal, worn brown, cream, and deep red keeps many textures coherent. Fine linework distinguishes hairlike strands, rough fur, ridged surfaces, and facial planes; broader shadow shapes preserve a strong hierarchy from a distance. Pale focal areas stand forward against darker mass, while a rough-edged flat color field provides graphic force. Light is cool and soft rather than flashy, allowing texture and overlapping profiles to create drama. The result feels solemn, layered, and posterlike, with densely observed surfaces held inside a compact composition.
style_prompt_zh: 细密的奇幻插画把几个靠近的剪影组织在更大、俯压的形体下。冷灰、炭色、旧褐、奶油色与深红的克制色阶使多种肌理保持统一。细线分出发丝、粗毛、隆起表面和面部平面；较宽阴影从远处仍保留强层级。浅色焦点从深色体块前凸出，粗边平涂色域提供图形力量。光偏冷且柔和，不炫目，让肌理与重叠侧面产生戏剧感。成品庄严、层次丰富且近似海报，以紧凑构图容纳密集观察的表面。
theme_en: Four cloaked figures before a great gray dragon and torn red field
theme_zh: 四名披斗篷的人立于巨大的灰龙和破边红色背景前
name: Game of Thrones
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
